messages:
jun: Quick question — we keep running into inconsistent behavior when a project-level API key is rotated: routing sometimes falls back to an org key, quotas get attributed to the wrong owner, and our traces lose the project tag. Can we agree on a standard fallback + telemetry pattern?

maya: +1. we should decide 3 things: routing precedence, quota attribution, and what telemetry fields to emit.

sarah: Proposed pattern from my side: 1) prefer exact project-scoped key 2) fallback to org-level only if the request explicitly includes project_id in the payload and the org key has project delegation enabled 3) deny fallback for keys marked "no-delegate".

jun: That sounds sane. For the console UX, when a key would cause fallback we should show a warning in request logs: "delegated via org key" so customers can see where auth decisions happened.

rohit: On quotas — attribution MUST follow the effective project context, not the physical key. If the request carries project_id we attribute to that project even if an org key was used for auth, provided delegation was allowed. Otherwise attribute to the org.

maya: Telemetry fields suggestion: origin_key_type=[project|org|ephemeral], effective_project_id, delegated=true|false, key_id, auth_flow=[direct|impersonation|exchange]. Also include key_rotation_ts.

jun: Nice. Can we include a small example log line we can implement in runtime?

rohit: Sure — suggestion (JSON blob we emit in traces):
```
{"ts":"2024-11-02T18:22:31Z","req_id":"r-abc123","origin_key_type":"org","effective_project_id":"proj-42","delegated":true,"key_id":"k-987","auth_flow":"exchange","key_rotation_ts":"2024-10-30T02:00:00Z"}
```

devex-bot: NOTE: console change required — show "effective project" and a delegation badge when logs contain delegated=true.

maya: UX decision: when a key rotates we should emit a 1-week grace window for ephemeral exchange tokens to reduce cascading failures, but surface an alert in the key UI and send org admins an email. Grace window configurable per org.

sarah: Important edge-case — service accounts that do impersonation flows: the runtime currently creates ephemeral tokens via /v1/auth/exchange. We need to ensure those ephemeral tokens are marked origin_key_type=ephemeral and include a parent_key_id so we can tie usage back to the rotating key for billing/chargeback.

jun: Agreed. Also enforce: ephemeral tokens inherit project context from the exchange request; if none provided, they inherit from the parent key.

rohit: For rollout: propose canary 10% of dedicated and 5% of hosted traffic for 48h, with automatic rollback on: increase in 5xxs for routing decisions by >1.5x, or drop in project attribution telemetry >2x.

maya: Devex tasks: update docs + SDKs for the new telemetry fields, add a sample for exchanging org keys to project-delegated ephemeral keys.

jun: Ops tasks: add a telemetry index in logs (effective_project_id, origin_key_type) and a dashboard card that shows delegated requests over time and top offenders.

rohit: Security: require a console toggle for "allow org delegation" and audit log every toggle. Also rotate org-level keys more frequently if delegation enabled.

devex-bot: ACTIONS: @maya update SDK + docs, @rohit add telemetry dashboard, @sarah runtime impl for origin_key_type + parent_key_id.

maya: I'll open a PR for docs and a change to SDK header parsing today.

jun: if nobody objects I'll put up a short RFC describing the fallback rules + rollout plan by EOD. :thumbsup:

sarah: No objections from me. small nit: log key_id as short hash, not raw key.

rohit: +1 to hash. Also ensure PII review for telemetry.

jun: Cool — thanks all. We'll keep the console message language simple: "Request authorized via org delegation — effective project X."

ops-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled canary rollout window created: start=2024-11-05T14:00:00Z dur=48h percent-hosted=5 percent-dedicated=10

maya: linking follow-ups: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/credential-fallback (draft)

jun: end.
